PluginData.Author: Viktor
PluginData.Tooltip: Toggleable night vision built into the suit helmet and the cockpit glass.
PluginData.Description:
Adds a night vision mode in the style of Elite Dangerous: amplified green luminance with thin outlines on silhouettes, grain and a vignette.
The suit helmet provides it while the helmet is closed, on foot or in seats without glass. Cockpits with glass apply it only to what is seen through the glass.
Hold the light key (L) to toggle it; a tap still toggles the light. Shift + the light key works too. A three state cycle on the light key or a custom hotkey can be chosen in the plugin's Settings, along with the look and the HUD icon.
Purely local visual effect, nothing is synced.
